description: Yearly and monthly fuel cost and cost per mile for your driving, from an MPG figure, a kWh per 100 miles figure (EV) or a vehicle (year, make, model or id), at the national average gas, diesel and electricity prices fueleconomy.gov uses, or at your own price. Plug-in hybrids get gas-only, electric-only and an EPA utility-factor blend.

city_percent.description: Share of city driving in percent. Default 55.

electricity_price_per_kwh.description: Your own electricity price per kWh instead of the national average.

fuel.description: Fuel for an mpg figure. Default regular.

kwh_per_100_miles.description: EV consumption in kWh per 100 miles, if you are not naming a vehicle.

mpg.description: Miles per gallon, if you are not naming a vehicle.

price_per_gallon.description: Your own fuel price per gallon instead of the national average.

vehicle.description: A vehicle instead of an mpg figure.

id.description: fueleconomy.gov vehicle id instead of make and model (from fuel_economy_models).

name: fuel_cost_calculator
title: Fuel cost calculator
